title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Michael Jackson?
description:
Four real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Michael Jackson, through Vichy France's Marshal Pétain, a young François Mitterrand and Ronald Reagan.

Adolf Hitler → Philippe Pétain → François Mitterrand → Ronald Reagan → Michael Jackson

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Adolf Hitler → Marshal Pétain: In 1940, Hitler shook hands with Vichy France's leader, Marshal Pétain, at Montoire's train station.
   Photo by Heinrich Hoffmann, CC BY-SA 3.0 de: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bundesarchiv_Bild_183-H25217,_Henry_Philippe_Petain_und_Adolf_Hitler.jpg
2. Marshal Pétain → François Mitterrand: In 1942, Pétain received young François Mitterrand, a future president of France, at Vichy.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Fran%C3%A7ois_Mitterrand_1942.jpg
3. François Mitterrand → Ronald Reagan: In 1981, Mitterrand, now president of France, joined Ronald Reagan at the Yorktown bicentennial in Virginia.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Reagan_Mitterrand_1981.jpg
4. Ronald Reagan → Michael Jackson: And in 1984, at the White House, Ronald Reagan honored Michael Jackson himself.
   Photo by White House Photo Office, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Michael_Jackson_with_the_Reagans.jpg

Research notes: The 1942 photo of Pétain receiving Mitterrand stayed out of sight for 52 years until it appeared on the cover of a 1994 book, and it links Vichy straight to a president who later stood beside Reagan.

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#adolfhitler #michaeljackson #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
first_comment:
Fun fact from the research: Pétain stood beside President Hoover at Yorktown's 150th anniversary in October 1931. Exactly 50 years later, on 19 October 1981, Mitterrand stood there with Reagan for the 200th.

Who should Hitler connect to next? Name anyone (a character works too) and I'll find the photos.
